'''Lanoree Brock's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a [[Je'daii Master]] who taught at [[Bodhi]], the Temple of Arts, for the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] at the height of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] reign.

==Biography==
Trained as a member of the Je'daii Order, Brock met his future [[Lanoree Brock's mother|wife]] met as [[Je'daii Journeyer|Journeyers]] crossing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Tython on their [[Great Journey]]. Both of the young Je'daii were drawn to Bodhi Temple where [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] exposed their natural talents in the arts. A talented [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptor]] renowned across [[Masara]] continent, Brock was also skilled at cooking [[rumbat]] stew. Years after their Journey ended, Brock and his wife became the parents of [[Lanoree Brock|Lanoree]] and [[Dalien Brock]]. Living in the Je'daii settlement surrounding the Temple of Arts, Brock taught at Bodhi, amusing his students and colleagues with his magic tricks. One of his students, Master [[Xiang]], would later go on to teach under his watch. When his children were growing up, he would tell them tales and legends from Je'daii history, including a cautionary tale of [[Osamael Or]] and his fateful mission into the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

During the [[Despot War|war]] between Tython and [[Despot Queen]] [[Hadiya]] and her [[Despot Army|army]], Brock served some of his time on the planet [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] where the fighting was especially vicious. Following the war and the supposed death of his son, Brock rarely saw his daughter, who had become a [[Je'daii Ranger]] by the time of Dalien's reemergence during the [[Stargazer Uprising]].

==Personality and traits==
Brock wore his hair long, usually tied up, but allowed it to fall across his shoulders when at home. Brock believed that his son's inquisitive nature was a sign that he would make a fine Je'daii in time; he always believed that Dalien would find his own way. When spending time with his children, Brock would often take them to the [[Edge Forest]] where his explorer's heart would yearn to venture into its vastness.<ref name="Into the Void" />
